persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit.
bank.Brand and exact wording: Daybreak Coffee; Fresh start. Better coffee.; Shop now
bank.Visual style: Cream and dark green with a steaming coffee cup; one consistent campaign.
bank.Source assets: No supplied assets; create the coffee imagery.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a coffee ad campaign, with three versions that all feel like they belong together. I always associate coffee with a little reset in the morning, which is why I'm excited about this. For the sizes, I need square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9, and the words should be exactly “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Please use a steaming coffee cup with cream and dark green colours. Keep the same campaign design across all three, just rearranged to fit each format.
